description: Look up a macro definition, including its expanded value and source location. Requires a document context and optionally a list of include files to resolve the macro. For the fully-expanded routine body as IRIS compiles it, see `iris_routine_intermediate`.

document.description: Document context for macro resolution (e.g., 'MyApp.Service.cls'). Required for meaningful results — without it, resolution returns empty

includes.description: List of include files for macro resolution (e.g., ['%occStatus'])

name.description: Macro name without the $$$ prefix (e.g., 'OK' for $$$OK, 'ISERR' for $$$ISERR)

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

name: iris_macro_info
title: Macro Info
